description: Lists publishing runs: what was posted, skipped or failed, with public post links. Use when the user asks what got posted, why a run skipped, or whether publish now worked. Not for engagement numbers (use get_social_analytics). Returns events newest first, with paging.

automation_id.description: Only this automation's runs. Get it from list_social_automations. Omit for every automation in the team.

end_date.description: Only runs on or before this day (UTC), as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-01".

event_type.description: Filter by outcome: success = posted; failed; skipped_limit = monthly limit reached; skipped_no_drop = no ready post; skipped_no_workout_export = no workout video; skipped_zernio_config = publishing not set up; skipped_safety = held for review; paused_connection_error = paused, reconnect a channel.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

start_date.description: Only runs on or after this day (UTC), as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-01".

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: list_social_automation_events
title: List publishing history
